method.name: deterministic key-match + keyword heuristic
method.description:
Each scale article is classified in priority order:
1. redirect_stub: wikitext contains #REDIRECT or title in tier_1k.json redirect_stub_titles list.
2. confusable_adversarial: normalized title (via bp.norm_key) matches a core corpus normalized key, OR title contains keyword from defined confusable categories (Roman Empire, Nile, WWI/WWII, big cat species, disambiguation indicators).
3. background: fallback — no match detected.
4. unknown: fallback (should not occur).

Heuristic limits honestly:
- Surface‑level keyword/substring matching only; does NOT imply semantic relatedness to core topics.
- confusable_adversarial flags retrieval risk, not factual overlap.
- Keyword lists are finite and may miss edge cases; new confusable categories require manual update.
- Matching on norm_key catches case/casing variants but may produce false positives on unrelated titles that normalize identically.
- No article should be auto-counted as a false positive merely for coming from the distractor layer; top confusable retrievals must be adjudicated (see docs/scale-evaluation-rule.md).
